meta.title: IIT Jodhpur Academic Calendar AY 2026-27

source.publisher: IIT Jodhpur, Office of Academic Affairs

notices: If the Government of India announces any additional holiday on a working day, the buffer days of 18 November 2026 (Sem I) and 21 April 2027 (Sem II) will be observed as working days.
A regular course has an engagement of 13 lectures (50 minutes each) per credit; instructors may schedule extra classes in consultation with students.
There will be no extra classes on Gazetted Holidays.
Saturdays and Sundays within the examination period will be used for scheduling examinations.
All faculty members must report to the Institute before the physical reporting date of continuing students.
List of holidays for Semester II, AY 2026-27 is yet to be declared; it will be updated when notified by the Institute.
